breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification failed to resolve the conflict. Instead of choosing gamma-centered (shift=0 0 0) as the ground truth does, it invented a contradictory hybrid 'gamma-centered half-shift scheme' and then specified 'shift 1 1 1' (K_POINTS automatic 8 8 6 1 1 1), which is a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid — not gamma-centered. The ground truth removes the half-shift instruction entirely, keeping only the gamma-centered grid. The agent repeated and even compounded the original error.
